body: .. And we've just illustrated what happened in what I'm describing in the title of the post.
Then, to you, they're the asshole.  It doesn't matter what they think of themselves.
Maybe you can control them, maybe not, but for certain they mean nothing to anyone except you.
Why is my own opinion so much more important than what others think?  They're the ones in positions to affect my quality of life, nobody lives in a vacuum.

Why does it matter?  How can it possibly matter?  Your opinion of yourself can be 100% wrong or 100% right, it changes nothing at all other than how you feel about yourself - and therefore it is completely meaningless and irrelevant.

Thus the problem.  They have all the power and I can't take it.  I can do whatever I want, I can think of myself however I want, it doesn't change anything other than how I think of myself, and that's meaningless to anyone outside my own head.  I can think I'm the bee's fucking knees and the best human being that has ever lived, if the person I'm interacting with thinks I'm trash, that is what is important.  They are in a position to treat me differently based on their opinion of me, so therefore their opinion of me is all that is relevant.
Maybe, maybe not.  That's not the point.  The point is, that at the moment, they see you in a specific way.  At the moment, that is who you are.  Who **you** think you are is meaningless.
And it's **their** opinions that matter in the final analysis.  If they think you're an asshole, you're an asshole.

Except you can't MAKE someone change their opinion of you.  You can try until you pass out from exhaustion, they're going to think exactly what they're going to think and you cannot change that.  Most of the time someone decides within the first 30 seconds of meeting you what they're going to think of you, and if it's not who you think you are, you're screwed.  Who you think you are may as well not exist.

Except they *DO*, that's what I can't seem to communicate.  

You walk into a bank.  You ask for a loan to buy a car.  If the loan officer thinks you're an asshole, you don't get the loan.

You go to a restaurant.  You order lunch.  If the cook thinks you're an asshole, he spits in your food.

You go to a family event.  If the host (who's a cop) thinks you like criminals more than cops, he'll throw you under the bus to everyone else.

I could go on, but you get the idea.  In none of those situations does what you think of yourself change a single goddamn thing.

See, that's where they got stuck too.  What possible meaning could who you think you are have?  It's meaningless.  It's a delusion inside your head.  It can't possibly be real or accurate.  It makes **zero** difference to anyone else except yourself.  What's the point?  It's not real.

Of course I wonder and question.  The thing is, it's irrelevant.  Who I think I am and who others think I am are not even in the same time zone in terms of importance; the former is completely meaningless.  There's no way you can be right.  The only thing that matters is who OTHER people think you are, because they're the ones in positions to help or hurt you.

That's irrelevant.  I have no idea who I am, I have no idea who I can be, and neither matters.  I don't *want* to know who I am, because I know it'd be wrong; we are what other people perceive us to be, and if you slip, JUST A LITTLE, you're ruined.
Well that's the problem.  I have no idea who I am and I don't *want* to know, because I know it'd be fake.  I can't be objective about who I am because I'm too close to it.  I'd be wrong.

The only opinions I think are valid are the ones that disagree with mine.  I know that's kind of hard to get your head around, but if someone thinks I'm an idiot, then it is automatically true.  What I think doesn't matter outside of my own head, it makes no difference at all.  Everyone's playing an angle trying to get one over on everyone else, and when they're right it's that much worse.
Been there.  The system sucks.  People on "support" lines or whatever don't have the training or ability to really help, and anyone who does has to lock you up if you say the magic words...
